candidates.label: BFS over (lo,hi)=(T(p),T(q)) state pairs by increasing depth (operations preserve order so only the endpoints matter), pruning to the Pareto frontier (max lo per hi, drop hi>s). Once minimal depth found, greedily rebuild the program preferring 'A' at each position, checking feasibility of completing within the remaining budget before committing. Hand-verified against all 4 given samples by tracing the algorithm by hand (not compiled/run).

Same algorithm but state values stored as 32-bit int instead of long long -- with a,m,p,q,r,s up to 1e9, a single multiply overflows int32 almost immediately, so this should diverge quickly even on modest inputs.
